crossRefs.note: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be…
saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’
Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of…
and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and…
If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.
Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.
redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They…
For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls…
Now therefore, don’t let my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of Yahweh; for the king of Israel has come…

translations.web: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
translations.bsb: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when wicked usurpers surround me?
translations.kjv: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass
translations.asv: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, When iniquity at my heels compasseth me about?
